historical_record.description: An existing single-story restaurant structure stood at the property.

The City Planning Commission approved conditional use authorization to allow the development of a lot greater than 10,000 square feet in an NC-3 Moderate-Scale Neighborhood Commercial District, demolishing the existing single-story restaurant structure and constructing a new four-story structure with up to 20 dwelling units and approximately 4,800 square feet of commercial space, with conditions.
